fields.statement: QA at e8d75459 with the built binary (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza), in a scratch clone of this repo whose own `rhiza health` takes 11.9 s. Ran `rhiza daemon --max-runs 1 --permission-mode plan` with rhiza.daemon.paused=true and rhiza.web.port=17891, then curl'd the real listener. Right after start: / answered 200 in 0.27 s and 0.14 s, /fragments/daemon in 0.019 s and 0.008 s, each with one 'Checking…' rz-pill--pending pill and no failed pills; 30 concurrent /fragments/daemon requests all answered under 0.1 s. About 10 s after start the report landed: / 0.16-0.17 s and /fragments/daemon 0.008-0.011 s showing 10 health pills (7 ok, 3 warn, e.g. 'daemon: ok · running…', 'autonomy: warn · daemon paused…'), live daemon status in them. Polling /fragments/daemon once a second for 45 s across the 30 s staleness mark: max 0.014 s, never pending again. Daemon CPU time: 40 s with no requests rose 1.0 s (poll loop only, no health run); one request on the stale report answered in 0.17 s and the next 15 s added 8.0 s CPU (one background health run), then 10 s idle added 0.3 s. `go test -trimpath -count=1 -run TestWebDaemon ./internal/api/` and `go test -trimpath ./internal/web/...` pass.
